notes.title: Sept 19 Event Update
notes.notes:
Sept 19 Event Preview

\[Gift Box]

1. Sunset Paint: The warm sunset spreads across the stage, with soft hues and delicate patterns intertwining to create a romantic and enchanting performance experience.

2. Pure Willow: Limited-time return gift box, where gentle breezes sway the willows and glowing fireflies dance, bringing an elegant and lively look back to the stage.



\[Stardust Summon]

1. Azure Feather: Light wings flutter with every move; this outfit features a color-change function, and colors can be switched using color-change cards.

2. Water Spirit: Clear and pure like morning dew, the water-element outfit returns for a limited time.



\[Lucky Star]

Doggy Love: Soft and romantic design, as if the stage is bathed in a gentle glow, making every performance deeply moving.



\[Wish]

Azure Feather Mount: A brand-new fireworks mount that can release full-server fireworks once every 24 hours, instantly lighting up the stage and becoming the center of attention.



\[New Songs]

This period features 5 new songs with gorgeous rhythms and perfect dance steps, inviting you and your friends to dance together:

1. bloodline

2. Guitar on Fire

3. Beautiful

4. She's All I Wanna Be

5. Don't Call Me Up



\[Anniversary Celebration Phase 3]

1. Anniversary Exchange Shop: New Peachy Look outfit and limited avatar frame available.

2. Dating Mode: Limited-time feature; participating grants abundant anniversary coins and exclusive decorations.

3. New Century Proposal: During the event, use Driving for Love to obtain the 'King of Roses' ring.

4. Romantic Puzzle: Complete puzzle tasks to earn large amounts of anniversary coins and illuminate your exclusive sweet memories.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.notes:
Dear Idols,

Thank you for your continued support and feedback on Idol Party. We are committed to improving the game and providing a better experience for everyone. We are excited to announce some upcoming updates:

This Week's Update

Adding More High-Difficulty Songs: We know many players are looking for more challenges, so this week we will add several new high-difficulty songs to bring more fun and excitement to your gameplay.
Adding 5x, 6x, 7x, and 8x Speed Options: To cater to different player preferences, we will introduce multiple speed options, allowing you to choose the speed that suits your play style.

Next Week's Update Plan

Custom Key Bindings: We will launch a key binding modification feature in the game, allowing players to customize controls according to their habits for a more convenient experience.
Fixing Various Issues Preventing Game Access: We have identified and fixed several issues that were preventing some players from accessing the game. These fixes will be included in next week's update.

Future Update Plans

Fixing Issues with Viewing Mails: We will address the issue where some players cannot see mail content, ensuring that important information is not missed.
Fixing Clothing Issues: We have noticed that some clothing items cause characters to lose their upper bodies, and this will be fixed in a future update.
Adding Push and Pull Camera Functions for Screenshot Angles: We will add push and pull camera buttons to help players better adjust screenshot angles.
Adding Borderless Window Mode: Multi-monitor users will be able to switch between screens more conveniently with the addition of a borderless window mode.
Fixing Traditional Mode Background Camera Issues: In traditional mode, turning off the background camera leads to chaotic switching. We have confirmed this issue and will fix it soon.
Adding Restart Button in Single-Player Mode: We will add a restart button in single-player mode, allowing players to restart the game midway through.
We hope these updates will enhance your gaming experience. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please leave a comment below. We are continuously working on improvements!

Thank you once again for your support and feedback. Let's look forward to these exciting improvements together!

Best regards,
The Idol Party Development Team
